Find the value of $w$ in the triangle shown above.
question.worked_solution:
First, from the diagram, notice that $∠RTS$ and $∠STU$ are supplementary. Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠RTS+m∠STU & ={180}^{∘} \\ m∠RTS+w & ={180}^{∘} \\ m∠RTS & ={180}^{∘}-w.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $△RST$ is an isosceles triangle where $\overset{―}{RT}≅\overset{―}{TS}$, the base angles must be equal:

$$
m∠S=m∠R={39}^{∘}.
$$

Finally, since the interior angles of any triangle sum to ${180}^{∘},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠R+m∠S+m∠RTS & ={180}^{∘} \\ {39}^{∘}+{39}^{∘}+({180}^{∘}-w) & ={180}^{∘} \\ {39}^{∘}+{39}^{∘}-w & =0 \\ w & ={78}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$
